catalog.title: Scribble Picture 17
catalog.process_notes:
The creatures are creeping in.

Having fun with these scribble pictures. I didn't expect to get to the 17th one already.

None of them have been printed yet. I'm looking at a target print size of 24x36. This scribble picture was adjusted to hit that poster size. I'm likely to print with a border, so now there is room for a digital signature outside of the print.
catalog.print_note: Digitally signed open edition, print alone or framed print:

described.alt_text: A photograph of a midtown Manhattan avenue with cartoon clouds drawn down the sky, creatures peeking from a yellow brick tower's windows, a rainbow checkered pavement, and a bronze statue given a cartoon head, signed 2023.
described.description: A portrait format digital piece on a photograph inside a white border, signed 2023 at lower right. A tall thin supertall tower rises at centre top, wrapped in a column of outlined white cartoon clouds that descends to the street. A brown stone building at left has drawn boxes and antennae on its roof and a flat beige tower drawn beside it. A yellow brick tower at right has small grey cartoon creatures with eyes, horns and ears peeking from a dozen windows, and a triangle drawn on its facade. In the street, faceless pedestrians walk past a bronze statue of a seated figure whose head has been replaced by a grey cartoon head with a finger raised. A food cart with a red umbrella and a bus stand at right. The pavement in the foreground is redrawn as a checkerboard of pastel pink, blue, green, yellow and lilac tiles.
described.impression: The creatures are creeping in, as the process note says: they have moved into the windows of a midtown tower and are watching the street. The cloud column and the rainbow pavement make the avenue a stage, and the statue with the cartoon head is the master of ceremonies. This is where the Scribble series turns from annotating photographs to colonising them.
described.format_notes: Digital drawing over a Fujifilm X-H2 photograph, print layout with white border. Process notes discuss a 24 by 36 inch print target. Print available.
